description: This file defines a Language controller class for the admin startup process in an OpenCart-based project. It manages the loading of language data based on default settings, cookies, and language extensions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language settings during the startup process in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads available languages and sets the current language based on configuration or cookie.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Loads language data after initial loading, supporting extension overrides and avoiding infinite loops.
